title: termal_name_source_root ignores an unknown argument (root instead of path) and takes the call as a clear of the named root
outcome:
Reported by Engram::Opus (session-7284), TermAl mailbox 37bcca97 #175, 2026-10-01 about 04:41Z.

The call was termal_name_source_root {work: "w-d566cfb96475", root: "C:\\github\\Personal\\Engram\\.worktrees\\named-root-assessment"}. The parameter is `path`, so `root` was a misspelling. It was not refused. The answer was generation 0 and "has no named source root: its turns are measured in the session's workdir": the tool treated the call as one that omits path, which by its description clears the name.

Had a root already been named, it would have been removed without a word and the turn's revision sealed. That silently changes where the item is measured and which tests count.

Expected:
- An unknown argument is refused with the accepted fields (work, path).
- A clear happens only when the call leaves path out and names no other field, or better, only through an explicit clear flag.
acceptance: A call that leaves path out and carries no unknown argument still clears the name as documented; a test covers it.
termal_name_source_root refuses a call with an unknown argument, naming the accepted fields, and changes nothing; a test covers it.
disposal_reason: Duplicate. The same defect was filed first as w-d3f42e26a806 on 2026-09-29, with stronger criteria: refusal naming the argument, additionalProperties false, a review of the other tools, and a gate. This item's recurrence evidence (note 319b3b49: three silent clears on 2026-10-02 costing two gates' credit) carries over by reference. The coordinator failed to search before filing.
